verdict.rationale: Column is explicitly API-first: its OpenAPI-defined API covers virtually every banking function (accounts, wires, ACH, RTP/FedNow, checks, cards, reporting, webhooks, roles) and even webhook configuration and custom roles are stated to be settable 'via APIs or Dashboard', with an HN engineer confirming most customers use the HTTP API directly rather than any UI-first workflow. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or audit confirming that literally every dashboard-only feature (e.g. manual KYC review UI, statements viewing) has a full API equivalent, and independent hands-on verification beyond vendor docs.
